  "research_question": "Do stimulation paradigms (Combined, ICMS Only, Dim Visual Only, Bright Visual Only, Sham) differentially affect mouse navigation performance as measured by Time-to-Target, Success, Path Efficiency, Average Speed, and Angular Dispersion (AD)?",
  "stim_paradigms_compared": ["Combined", "ICMS Only", "Dim Visual Only", "Bright Visual Only", "Sham"],
  "response_variables": ["Time-to-Target", "Success", "Path Efficiency", "Average Speed", "AD"],
  "anova_plan": [
    "For Time-to-Target: One-way ANOVA with Stim Paradigm as fixed factor. The variable is continuous with n=76655, mean=2.81s, sd=2.08s. Range 0.5-201.4s suggests right skew; log-transformation or robust ANOVA should be considered. Group means vary substantially: Sham (4.68s) > Dim Visual Only (3.14s) > ICMS Only (3.05s) > Bright Visual Only (2.61s) > Combined (2.56s).",
    "For Success: Binary outcome (0/1) with mean 0.73. Standard ANOVA inappropriate due to binary nature. Recommended: logistic regression with Stim Paradigm as categorical predictor, or chi-square test of independence. Group proportions: Combined (0.780), Bright Visual Only (0.785), Dim Visual Only (0.673), ICMS Only (0.685), Sham (0.273).",
    "For Path Efficiency: Continuous ratio variable (0-1 theoretically, though max=29.8 suggests outliers). One-way ANOVA with Stim Paradigm; consider gamma GLM or log-transformation due to right skew and bounded nature. Group means: Combined (0.502), Bright Visual Only (0.504), Dim Visual Only (0.434), ICMS Only (0.432), Sham (0.308).",
    "For Average Speed: Continuous positive variable. One-way ANOVA appropriate; check for heteroscedasticity. Group means: Combined (12.83), Bright Visual Only (12.68), ICMS Only (12.04), Dim Visual Only (11.97), Sham (10.74).",
    "For AD (Angular Dispersion): Continuous bounded [0,1] variable. One-way ANOVA with caution; consider beta regression or arcsine transformation due to bounded nature. Group means: Combined (0.399), Bright Visual Only (0.387), ICMS Only (0.354), Dim Visual Only (0.336), Sham (0.236)."
  ],
  "assumptions_and_diagnostics": [
    "Independence: Violated by repeated measures structure (8 mice, 76655 trials). Mouse ID must be included as random effect in mixed models.",
    "Normality: Time-to-Target and Path Efficiency show extreme right skew (max values >> mean + 3*sd). Shapiro-Wilk inappropriate for large n; use Q-Q plots and assess skewness/kurtosis.",
    "Homoscedasticity: Levene's test for each continuous variable. Sham group has smaller n=3505 and appears more variable on some metrics.",
    "Sample size imbalance: Combined dominates (63.7% of data), Sham smallest (4.6%). Weighted analyses or mixed models with REML recommended.",
    "For Success (binary): No ANOVA assumptions apply; logistic regression assumptions (linearity in logit, no perfect separation) must be checked."
  ],
  "posthoc_plan": [
    "If omnibus ANOVA significant for Time-to-Target, Path Efficiency, Average Speed, or AD: Tukey HSD or Games-Howell (if variance heterogeneity) for pairwise comparisons among 5 paradigms. Focus on Sham vs. active stimulation conditions and Combined vs. unimodal conditions.",
    "For Success (logistic regression): Estimated marginal means with Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons, or specific contrasts (e.g., Combined vs. Sham, Combined vs. ICMS Only).",
    "Effect sizes: Cohen's d for continuous variables, odds ratios for Success. Report 95% confidence intervals.",
    "Multiplicity correction: 5 response variables × multiple comparisons; consider Bonferroni or FDR control across the family of tests."
  ],
  "expected_findings": [
    "Sham expected to show poorest performance: highest Time-to-Target (4.68s), lowest Success rate (27.3%), lowest Path Efficiency (0.308), lowest Average Speed (10.74), and lowest AD (0.236).",
    "Combined stimulation expected superior or near-superior across metrics: fastest Time-to-Target (2.56s), high Success (78.0%), high Path Efficiency (0.502), fastest Average Speed (12.83), highest AD (0.399).",
    "Bright Visual Only may match or approach Combined performance, notably high Success (78.5%) and competitive Time-to-Target (2.61s).",
    "ICMS Only and Dim Visual Only intermediate: similar Time-to-Target (~3.0s), Success (~67-69%), Path Efficiency (~0.43), with Dim Visual Only showing slightly lower AD (0.336 vs 0.354).",
    "Visual stimulation (Bright) may outperform tactile (ICMS) when delivered alone; multimodal benefit suggested by Combined performance."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Severe group size imbalance: Combined (n=48846) vs Sham (n=3505) creates precision disparities and potential for Type II error in Sham comparisons.",
    "Repeated measures structure ignored in standard ANOVA: 8 mice contribute unequal trials, inducing within-subject correlation that inflates Type I error if unaddressed.",
    "Right skew and outliers in Time-to-Target and Path Efficiency violate normality; means may not represent central tendency well.",
    "Success is binary: ANOVA inappropriate, yet requested. Logistic regression or mixed-effects logistic regression required.",
    "No information on trial sequence, learning effects, or session structure; temporal confounds possible.",
    "AD bounded [0,1] but treated as continuous; values near boundaries may violate variance assumptions.",
    "Missing covariates: target distance, trial difficulty, or environmental factors not available for adjustment."
  ],
  "recommended_next_analysis": "Fit linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) for Time-to-Target, Path Efficiency, Average Speed, and AD with Stim Paradigm as fixed effect and Mouse as random intercept; use generalized linear mixed model (GLMM, binomial) for Success. Apply log-transformation or gamma family for skewed continuous outcomes. Conduct likelihood ratio tests for paradigm effects, followed by estimated marginal means with Tukey adjustment for pairwise comparisons. Report intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) to quantify mouse-level clustering."
}
